calculation.taxableWageBasis: Gross taxable wages expected to be reported in federal Form W-2 Box 1
calculation.roundingRule: Not stated in the captured forms
calculation.supplementalWages: The elected percentage applies to gross taxable wages; no separate supplemental-wage method is stated in the captured A-4 publications.

residencyAndWorkRules.residentRule: Withholding is required from Arizona residents for services performed in Arizona.
residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentRule: Withholding is required for a nonresident who performs services in Arizona for 60 days or more in the calendar year; an employee may elect and an employer may begin withholding before day 60.
underThresholdConditions: The employer is not owned or controlled directly or indirectly by an Arizona resident or corporation.
The employer has no payroll in Arizona and no property or sales in Arizona other than the employee's presence.
The employee is present in Arizona for fewer than 60 days during the calendar year.
daysExcludedFromThreshold: Training not directly connected with Arizona employment

decemberEmployerElection.effect: A qualifying employer may elect not to withhold Arizona income tax during December 2026 after filing the election and notifying affected employees.
decemberEmployerElection.employeeResponse: Employees may submit a revised A-4 to account for the election.

filing.annualEligibility: Prior four-quarter average withholding of $200 or less plus the other official eligibility criteria
filing.aboveQuarterlyRange: Use the same monthly, semiweekly, or next-business-day deposit schedule that applies for federal withholding.

captureWarnings: The official filing-obligations page rejected direct retrieval with HTTP 403; its manually printed PDF is checksummed separately because it is not byte-identical to the HTML source.
No explicit rounding instruction or distinct supplemental-wage method was located in the captured 2026 A-4 publications.
The unusual December employer election must be modeled as an employer-level effective-period override, not as an employee tax rate.

review.requiredNextStep: Verify rounding and supplemental treatment, implement conditional day counting and the December employer election, and add boundary tests before activation.
